tiles.name: wang_13
tiles.description: transparent background and Natural excavated mine bedrock ledge, broad irregular dark slate rock strata in charcoal muted plum and dark umber. Chunky connected unworked stone with a few deep cracks and large quiet solid planes. NOT a brick wall, NO rectangular brick pattern, NO masonry blocks, NO mortar grid. Front orthographic side-view platform with clean pixel clusters, top-left light, two or three shades per material, no tiny flecks, no dithering, no texture noise. - wang_13

terrain_prompts.lower: Natural excavated mine bedrock ledge, broad irregular dark slate rock strata in charcoal muted plum and dark umber. Chunky connected unworked stone with a few deep cracks and large quiet solid planes. NOT a brick wall, NO rectangular brick pattern, NO masonry blocks, NO mortar grid. Front orthographic side-view platform with clean pixel clusters, top-left light, two or three shades per material, no tiny flecks, no dithering, no texture noise.
terrain_prompts.upper: A generous flat walkable stone floor surface: broad worn warm taupe and muted brown slate flagstones laid nearly level, shallow uneven facets, no shiny gray continuous stripe, no loose stones, no bumps, no grass. Calm readable surface for characters to stand on. Warm charcoal-taupe versus cooler deep slate beneath. Clear hand-pixelled chunky fantasy game art, native low resolution, no painted look. Seamless horizontal level ground tile.

pattern_system.description: 4×4 patterns with wildcards for flexible tile matching

pattern_layout.description: 4×4 grid where center 2×2 matches tile corners, outer ring uses wildcards

example.row_1: Wildcard + NW corner + NE corner + Wildcard
example.row_2: Wildcard + SW corner + SE corner + Wildcard

usage.description: Sample 4×4 terrain around tile position, encode as pattern key, lookup in cache

game_engines.instructions: Import PNG, create Tilemap and Grid, configure tile collision with TilemapCollider2D
